subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should `diagnostics.otel.captureContent.outputMessages` export Claude Code CLI `thinking` blocks, or only assistant content visible in the final user-facing reply?
rationale: The implementation intentionally includes thinking for parity with native model capture, but this expands the set of sensitive content exported to third-party telemetry systems and cannot be resolved from tests or semantic conventions alone.

options.title: Exclude CLI thinking
options.body: Capture visible assistant text and tool identity but omit Claude `thinking` blocks from diagnostic output content.

options.title: Approve native-capture parity
options.body: Keep thinking capture under the existing opt-in trusted policy and explicitly accept and document that privacy boundary.

options.title: Define one unified policy
options.body: Pause this PR until native and CLI reasoning capture share a repository-wide documented contract and matching tests.

recommendation.title: Exclude CLI thinking
recommendation.body: Capture visible assistant text and tool identity but omit Claude `thinking` blocks from diagnostic output content.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the capture boundary, supplied the consistency rationale, and have MEMBER association plus the maintainer review context on this PR.
